steps.decide: Which fields exist because the record needs them and which are imported habit
Which fields save immediately and which save on submit, and how the difference is shown
Conflict behaviour when the record changed while it was open
Destructive action confirmation and what is recoverable

rules.statement: A field exists because a decision or a legal obligation needs it; imported habit fields are removed rather than hidden.
One save model per form, stated on the form: either it saves on submit or it autosaves per field, never both silently.
When the record changed elsewhere, the form says what changed and offers a choice; it never overwrites a colleague's edit silently.
Deletion is recoverable (soft delete or undo) or requires typed confirmation naming the record; a single unlabelled button is not enough.
Submit disables on press, the handler refuses a second in-flight save for the same record, and the write carries an idempotency key so a retried save cannot create a duplicate record.
A failed save keeps every entered value and attaches the error to the field or the form; losing typed work is never the failure treatment.
Below the reflow threshold the form is a single labelled column with the primary save reachable without covering a field (no fixed bar overlapping the last input).

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a save response for a superseded record version is discarded and surfaced as a conflict instead of applied

motion.noneReason: a save gets its result, not an animation
blocking the form visually is what the guard is for; movement would hide the values being saved
motion.reducedMotion: labels state the work and the form stays editable but guarded

motion.noneReason: a save that fades in reads as uncertain
motion.reducedMotion: confirmation appears instantly with the record's new state

motion.noneReason: typed work must never be obscured by an animation
motion.reducedMotion: the error appears instantly and every entered value stays

motion.noneReason: staying on the record is not a transition worth animating

refused.reason: a conflicted form cannot be submitted until the operator chooses a version
nothing has been saved while the conflict is unresolved
